# dsh-user-portrait
> A DSH Host/Client plugin that learns your habits, skills and preferences from everyday conversatio
ns and work summaries — a reviewable portrait for resumes and self-review, plus a prompt hint and to
ols that let the model consult it on demand.
English | 中文
## What it does
- **Per-turn extraction.** After each turn a background job asks the model for a short “what I asked
/ key points / what you answered / corrections” digest and appends the evidence to a ledger. A turn

with no new evidence makes no model call.
- **Nine dimensions.** Daily life (personality & communic
ation, interests, background, current focus, recent state) and technical (skills & stack, working st

yle, boundaries, sensitivities).
- **Resume and self-review material.** Skills, working style and ba

ckground accumulate as evidence and can be exported as Markdown.
- **Every conclusion is verifiable.
** It carries a confidence level, a basis (your words / the model's answer / both) and its source se

ssions. Similar conclusions are merged; conflicting ones supersede the old entry.
- **Reviewable and
correctable.** The right-side panel has four tabs (dimensions, my notes, session log, evidence time
line) with editing, confidence up/down, retire and restore, permanent delete, search, Markdown expor

t and a conclusion cap.
- **Four model tools.** `portrait_read`, `portrait_search`, `portrait_histor

y`, `portrait_maintain`.
- **Opt-in prompt hint.** The portrait is not injected into the system prom
pt by default. Turn it on next to the composer and a short “portrait is available” note is added.
## Install
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Restart DSH or reload the plugin. It is plain ESM with no build step and no extra dependencies.
## Using it
- Open it from the **User Portrait** tab in the right sidebar, the portrait button in the session he

ader, or Settings → User Portrait.
- **Dimensions:** search, add/edit, conclusion cap and export at

the top; the daily and technical groups below.
- **My notes:** notes outrank automatic conclusions a

nd are never overwritten by extraction.
- **Session log:** a per-session summary plus each turn's “w

hat I asked / what you answered”.
- **Evidence timeline:** the evidence ledger, with the original ex

cerpts.
- **Two levels of delete:** deleting on a dimension card marks an entry retired (restorable)
; permanent delete in the discard area removes it and blacklists its evidence (with a second confirm
nent delete in the discard area removes it and blacklists its evidence (with a second confirmation).
| Tool | What it does |
| `portrait_read` | Read the portrait; filter by `dimension`, include history with `includeRetired`

|
| `portrait_search` | Search the evidence ledger and turn records by keyword |
| `portrait_history

` | Read session summaries and per-turn key points |
| `portrait_maintain` | Correct entries and not
es, plus `backfill` / `redigest` / `synthesizeNow` |
## Configuration
Set these in cordis.patch.yml; changes take effect after a restart.
| Key | Default | Meaning |

| `dataDir` | empty (→ `DSH_HOME/user-portrait`) | Portrait directory; relative or absolute |
| `ena

bled` | `true` | Master switch |
| `loadHint` | `true` | Allow the “portrait is available” prompt se

ction; each session still has to switch it on |
| `backfillOnStart` | `true` (shipped patch: `false`

) | Process history on startup |
| `synthesizeEveryTurns` | `1` | Merge the portrait every N turns (

`0` disables automatic merging) |
| `turnSynthesisDelayMs` | `3000` | Coalescing window for the per-

turn merge |
| `minEvidenceForSynthesis` | `3` | Skip a merge with fewer new evidence rows |
| `roll

upOnDispose` | `true` | Rewrite a session roll-up when its agent is disposed |
| `sessionRollupMinTu

rns` | `3` | Sessions with fewer turns get no model-written roll-up |
| `provider` / `model` | empty

| Model route for background extraction; empty means the current default model |
| `feedbackUrl` |

empty | Target of the feedback button; empty keeps it disabled |
| `limits.perUserMessage` | `6000`

| Character cap for one user message before extraction |
| `limits.perAssistantTurn` | `4000` | Char

acter cap for one assistant turn before extraction |
| `limits.synthesisEvidence` | `80` | Maximum e

vidence rows per merge |
| `limits.maxOutputTokens` | `4000` | Output cap for an extraction call; a
capped reply is discarded |
## Data & privacy
- The default data directory is `<DSH_HOME>/user-portrait` (`~/.dsh/user-portrait` when `DSH_HOME` i

s unset).
- Everything is plain text: `profile.json`, `profile.md`, `evidence.jsonl`, `state.json`,

`blacklist.json`, `deleted.log`, plus `sessions/`, `turns/` and `views/`.
- The plugin reads full se
ssion transcripts and sends its extraction prompts to the model configured in DSH. It makes no other

network requests.
- Secrets are masked before anything is written or sent: `sk-`, `ghp_`, `AKIA`, J
WTs, private keys, `password=`.
